title: INT8 weight-only (GPTQ/AWQ) - cross-lingual telemetry, synthetic stress & regression harness
creator: Asha Kapoor
description: Integrate INT8 weight-only quantization profiles (GPTQ and AWQ variants) into the regression and CI harness with an emphasis on cross-lingual accuracy telemetry and deterministic synthetic stress tests. The goal is to detect subtle accuracy regressions introduced by new kernel/packing changes, calibration noise, or schedule changes that disproportionately affect non-English tokenization and long-tail prompts. This ticket covers test data selection, telemetry metrics, CI gating rules, and a small canary workflow for staged rollouts.
acceptance_criteria: CI job 'int8-wo-regression' runs on PRs touching runtime/quant or kernel selection with deterministic output seeds
Regression suite contains at least 120 golden prompts across 6 languages (en, es, fr, zh, ar, ru) and covers short, medium, and long contexts
Telemetry shows token-level per-model accuracy deltas and per-language drift; alerts fire for >1.5% absolute accuracy drop on P0 prompts or >3% on language buckets
Canary rollout plan documented: 5% traffic -> 20% -> 100% with automated rollback trigger on accuracy or latency SLO breach
Documentation updated with instructions for adding new profiles (GPTQ vs AWQ) and a checklist for back-compat checks
test_plan: Create synthetic stress harness that replays replay-captured sessions + adversarial prompts with fixed RNG seed
Add cross-lingual golden set: 20 prompts per language, annotated with expected top-1 equivalence (soft-matching rules allowed)
Run nightly matrix of: model families (small/med/large), quant profile (GPTQ/AWQ/FP8 baseline), sequence lengths (64/512/2048), and batch sizes (1/8/32)
Measure metrics: top-1 token match rate, ROUGE-L for multi-token spans, per-token latency, KV-cache hit ratio, and calibration variance
Instrument telemetry to tag results by kernel variant, quant pipeline version, and calibration seed
Implement CI gating: block merges when regression delta exceeds thresholds for P0 prompts or when flaky rate >2% on smoke runs
Add a Canary dashboard with per-release diffs and ability to compare arbitrary runs side-by-side
